statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The current session is two-sided, with Nasdaq opening strength reversing while long Treasury yields retreat.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; risk is concentrated around the FOMC-minutes sequence and possible delayed rates-to-equity repricing.
headline: Two-sided Nasdaq trade keeps Tail low ahead of the FOMC-minutes sequence
body: The Nasdaq reversed opening gains into a modest decline while the Dow and S&P 500 remained positive and the 10-year Treasury yield fell toward 4.65%, arguing against a persistent one-way path. Semiconductor weakness and elevated oil/Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme. The main conditional window centers on the FOMC minutes and subsequent rate-sensitive price discovery.

lookbackSummary: Tail climbed into the low-30s during Tuesday's technology-led selloff, then declined overnight and through Wednesday morning as the prior one-way pressure lost persistence and cross-asset conditions became more mixed.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail rises into the 20:00 Berlin FOMC minutes and peaks during the possible delayed bond-to-equity interpretation window. Risk decays overnight if retracements and cross-asset stabilization emerge, then rises again around Thursday's 14:30 Berlin labor and manufacturing releases.

forecast.analysis: Observed trade is two-sided: the Nasdaq reversed opening gains to about -0.3% while the 10-year yield eased near 4.65%. That weakens the case for a persistent no-retracement path despite semiconductor and oil stress.
